manifest.policy: Immutable common FP64 Bernstein matrices/RHS, natural (p+1)x(p+1) BSR, no outer scaling, explicit zero guess each solve. Serial synchronized GPU jobs. One warmup setup and three measured setups, two zero-guess solves per setup; mean hot time uses second solve of each measured setup. Failures retained and excluded from ranks. Configuration frozen per case; no tuning at each h/p point.

completion.note: Completed means all planned configurations were attempted; failed configurations remain visibly failed.
